chars.A: AMMAR: a 35-year-old man wearing a mustard-yellow bomber jacket over a white t-shirt, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.K: KAWTAR: a young woman wearing a burgundy satin blouse, long black skirt and big gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, hallway of a modern Casablanca apartment building. AMMAR stands at the apartment front door holding a bouquet of red roses and a small black rolling suitcase, grinning mischievously with one mitten finger on his lips. Through the frosted glass panel of the door, the dark blurry silhouette of KAWTAR is visible inside, laughing. Funny sneaky surprise mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a red Casablanca petit taxi at dusk, AMMAR sits in the back seat, red roses on his lap, smiling happily and impatiently, city lights and palm trees through the window.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night street in Casablanca: AMMAR gets out of a red petit taxi in front of a white apartment building with balconies, pulling his black rolling suitcase, roses in hand, looking up at a lit window with excitement.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close view at the apartment front door at night: AMMAR slowly and carefully turns a key in the lock, tiptoeing, roses under his arm, suitcase beside him, sneaky comic expression.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Dark Moroccan living room with sedari sofas and a carved wooden table, only moonlight. AMMAR tiptoes inside, leaving the suitcase by the door, roses in hand, looking toward an inner staircase where warm light comes from upstairs.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a duplex apartment at night: AMMAR halfway up an indoor staircase, roses in hand, freezing mid-step with one ear turned upward, surprised eyebrows, warm light coming from upstairs.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Upstairs hallway at night: AMMAR stands frozen in front of a closed bedroom door with warm light glowing under it, the roses drooping in his hand, puzzled and worried.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Upstairs hallway at night: AMMAR presses his ear against the closed bedroom door, eyes wide, nervous awkward half smile, roses held behind his back, light glowing under the door.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Upstairs hallway at night: AMMAR, sweating, one mitten hand on his chest, the other slowly reaching toward the bedroom door handle, roses fallen on the floor, shocked tense expression, light under the door.
